why: What the tests will need from KeePassDX's own screens, written BEFORE harvesting them (2026-10-02), so that the harvest can be compared with it.
rule: The harvest taps navigation only, from the lists below. It never taps a switch, a row inside a settings category, a Save or Validate button, Add node, or anything that changes data. A tap target that is not found stops that screen: nothing is guessed.
corrections: First harvest, 2026-10-02: the list's More-options menu holds only Save data, Merge data and Reload data (a popup window). Settings is not there: it is menu_app_settings in the NAVIGATION DRAWER. The prediction list.overflow/settings_item and lock_all was wrong (Lock is in the drawer too: menu_lock_all).

First harvest: the entry screen has no More-options button. Save, Merge and Reload data are buttons in its toolbar (menu_save_database and so on). The screen entry.overflow was removed; the Settings path was changed to go through the drawer.
First harvest: a popup menu is a window named PopupWindow:<hash> without an activity; the table of dialogs answers it with Back (rule popup-menu).

Settings harvest: the category row is called 'App settings', not 'Application'; the other rows are 'Form filling', 'Device unlocking', 'Appearance', 'Database settings', 'Security' and 'Master key' (the last three need an open database and belong to the database, not to the app).
